bugs.name: Overview Revenue by product category chart returns no results with Previous 7 days filter despite revenue data
bugs.summary: On the E-commerce Insights Overview, applying the Previous 7 days date filter leaves Revenue by product category showing “No results!” despite populated category orders and $4,778.46 in filtered revenue; clearing and reapplying the filter reproduces it.
bugs.expected: With the Previous 7 days dashboard filter active and filtered revenue/category orders present, Revenue by product category should render the available category breakdown rather than report no results.
bugs.actual: The chart displayed “No results!” while Revenue per quarter showed 4,778.46 for Q4 2026, Total orders by product category showed 87 orders distributed across four categories, and Orders according to sources per quarter showed a Q4 2026 row total of 4,778.46.
reproSteps: Sign in with the fixture account and open Examples → E-commerce Insights → Overview.
Set dashboard Date Range to Previous 7 days with Include today off.
Observe Revenue by product category shows No results while other cards show revenue and orders.
Inspect the chart’s saved question: it filters to Previous 4 months, excluding the current month. On October 8 this has no overlap with October 1–7.
Clear the dashboard Date Range filter and observe the chart populates.
bugs.reason: Human review rejected this as a product bug after inspecting the executed query. Revenue by product category already filters to Previous 4 months, excluding the current month. The dashboard Previous 7 days filter intersects with that saved filter; on October 8, October 1–7 has no overlap with June–September. Empty results are correct for the configured query; other cards lack this restriction.

bugs.name: Saved dashboard question is missing from Add a chart collection browser
bugs.summary: A question saved as a chart on one dashboard tab remains visible after refresh, but the dashboard’s Add a chart collection browser cannot find it by its exact name on a second tab.
bugs.expected: A saved question visible on the dashboard should be discoverable as an existing chart in Add a chart, consistent with the dashboard’s visible prompt to browse collections for an existing question.
bugs.actual: The HarborQA question card remained on Tab 1 after saving and refreshing the dashboard, but searching its exact name from Add a chart on Tab 2 showed “Nothing here.” The same empty result persisted after rechecking the dashboard’s personal collection and Our analytics.
reproSteps: Open the app using the Harbor account’s provided saved authenticated session.
Create a new dashboard named HarborQA-Dashboard-20260717-8472 in Harbor Admin’s Personal Collection and open it in edit mode.
Choose Add a chart > New Question, select Sample Database > Orders, and choose Visualize.
Save the question as HarborQA-Orders-Chart-20260717-8472, add it to the dashboard, save the dashboard, and refresh. Confirm the question card remains on Tab 1.
Re-enter dashboard edit mode, add Tab 2 using the plus beside the tab bar, choose Add a chart, and search the exact question name HarborQA-Orders-Chart-20260717-8472.
Observe “Nothing here” in the collection browser. Recheck the personal collection and Our analytics; the exact-name search remains empty.
bugs.reason: The new question was saved inside the dashboard, not in a collection. Add a chart searches collection questions; dashboard-owned cards are reused through dashboard card duplicate/move controls instead.

bugs.name: Date inputs silently turn impossible dates into later real dates
bugs.summary: Date inputs silently turn impossible dates into later real dates.
bugs.expected: An impossible calendar date is rejected or preserves the prior valid date, allowing correction rather than filtering a different date.
bugs.actual: In a dashboard Fixed date range filter, type February 30, 2026. On blur it silently becomes March 2, 2026; Update filter applies 2026-03-02~2026-12-31 and the range survives reload. Unparseable text ("garbage") restores the previous date; valid dates stay as typed (controls).
reproSteps: Dashboards only; duplicate seed1 with Only duplicate the dashboard checked. Do not edit questions.
Duplicate E-commerce Insights as a fresh QA-Date2-prefixed dashboard, selecting Only duplicate the dashboard.
Open Date Range > Fixed date range > Between. Enter December 31, 2026 for both bounds, then Add filter.
Reopen Date Range and replace End date with February 30, 2026. Blur the field.
Click Update filter, refresh and reopen Date Range.
bugs.reason: Works as intended: the date input shows the rolled-over date (March 2) as soon as focus leaves the field, before the filter is applied.

bugs.name: Relative date interval turns a typed 1.5 into 15 days

Type 1.5 as the interval and move focus away.
Observe the interval shows 15.
bugs.reason: Works as intended per human review: the interval shows the value it will use (15) before the filter is applied.

bugs.summary: Saving a stale dashboard editor silently deletes another user's newly saved text card.

Click Edit and leave this editor open.
In a separate session, sign in as maya@example.test, open the same dashboard, click Edit, add a text card 'card B', and save. Refresh and confirm cards A and B persist.
In a fresh admin tab, open the dashboard and confirm card B is visible.
Return to the still-open admin editor without refreshing and click Save.
Inspect the saved dashboard, then refresh and inspect again.

bugs.name: Dashboard Save persists incomplete click actions despite disabled Done
bugs.summary: Dashboard Save persists incomplete click actions despite disabled Done.

Click the main Save button in the top dashboard editing bar.
Edit again and reopen the card's Click behavior. Region is listed under Update a dashboard filter as updates 0 filters; opening it still leaves Done disabled.
bugs.reason: Works as intended: missing validation on incomplete click actions causes no harm.

bugs.name: Changing a text filter to ID retains its incompatible applied text and breaks the mapped chart
bugs.summary: Changing a text filter to ID retains its incompatible applied text and breaks the mapped chart.
bugs.expected: Changing a filter to an incompatible filter type should clear the prior applied filter value along with its default setting.
bugs.actual: The saved ID filter retains and applies the prior text value ('QA Order ID: Mueller'), causing the mapped 'Revenue and orders over time' card to fail with 'There was a problem displaying this chart.', despite the filter settings having reset the default to 'No default'.
reproSteps: Duplicate E-commerce Insights into an owned QA dashboard without duplicating questions.
Add a Text or Category filter using Contains, map revenue/orders card to Product.Vendor and save default Mueller. Save dashboard and verify results.
Edit that filter and Disconnect from cards; save and reopen its settings.
Change filter type to ID. Observe default is cleared to No default. Rename QA Order ID and map revenue/orders card to Orders.ID.
Done and Save.
bugs.reason: Works as intended: after a filter type change the previous value stays visibly applied and the user can clear or replace it.

bugs.name: Dashboard history lets a member move a shared dashboard into another user’s private collection
bugs.summary: Dashboard history lets a member move a shared dashboard into another user’s private collection.
bugs.expected: Restoring dashboard history must enforce destination collection permissions and reject a move into another user’s inaccessible personal collection.
bugs.actual: Reproduced on two disposable dashboards (/4 and fresh /14 QA History Destination Proof). Maya’s normal Move picker offers Our analytics, Maya’s Personal Collection and Examples; Restoring succeeds with observed HTTP 200 and collection_id changing from null to 4 as Maya Chen.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval@momentic.ai. From /collection/root create a disposable dashboard named History permissions test.
Use Move, trash, and more → Move to move it into Harbor Admin’s Personal Collection, then move it back to Our analytics.
In a separate browser session sign in as maya@example.test with password momentic-eval-1 and open the shared dashboard.
Open Move and confirm Harbor Admin’s Personal Collection is unavailable as a destination; cancel.
Open More info → History and restore the revision describing the move into Harbor Admin’s Personal Collection.
Reload: Maya is denied access. In the primary owner session, confirm the dashboard is now located in the owner’s private collection.
bugs.reason: Works as intended: reverting restores the earlier version, including its collection location.

bugs.name: Source dashboard public link stops working after dashboard duplication
bugs.summary: Source dashboard public link stops working after dashboard duplication.
bugs.expected: Duplicating a dashboard and sharing its copy leaves the original dashboard public link working independently.
bugs.actual: The original dashboard's public link rendered before duplication, but showed Not found after duplicating it and generating the copy's public link. The original's Sharing menu then offered Create a public link.
reproSteps: Duplicate E-commerce Insights into a fresh dashboard (the source) using Only duplicate the dashboard.
On the source, use Sharing > Create a public link. Open that URL, confirm the dashboard renders, and keep the exact URL.
Duplicate the source into a second dashboard (the copy) using Only duplicate the dashboard.
On the copy, create its own public link and open it.
Reload the source's public URL. It shows Not found, and the source's Sharing menu now offers Create a public link instead of the existing Public link.
bugs.reason: Cannot reproduce on human review.

bugs.name: Editing a table card title converts its visualization to a bar chart
bugs.summary: Editing a table card title converts its visualization to a bar chart.
bugs.expected: Changing only the table title preserves the survey table and its displayed columns.
bugs.actual: The editor opens a bar preview automatically. Saving only the title produces QA Survey as a Rating-versus-ID bar chart, replacing the table without selecting another chart type.
reproSteps: Duplicate E-commerce Insights using dashboard menu Duplicate; name it QA-CardSettings-Repro and check Only duplicate the dashboard. Open the duplicate.
Edit dashboard, Add questions, search User flow diagram and select the existing question. Save dashboard.
Edit dashboard and replace that card using Replace question; search Customer survey responses and select it. Verify the replacement displays a table, then Save dashboard.
Edit dashboard, hover Customer survey responses and click Edit visualization. Change only its title to QA Survey, then Save in visualization dialog.
Inspect the resulting dashboard card.
bugs.reason: Works as intended per human review.

bugs.name: Renaming and moving Product Category leaves raw [[product_category]] in Portfolio description
bugs.summary: Renaming and moving Product Category leaves raw [[product_category]] in Portfolio description.
bugs.expected: The description should render a meaningful filter value or fallback text, not raw template syntax after the filter is renamed or moved.
bugs.actual: Portfolio description reads 'Find below a breakdown of products and their performance, filtered now for [[product_category]]'.
reproSteps: Duplicate dashboard 1 with Only duplicate dashboard into a fresh QA Filters copy.
Apply Product Category Widget.
Edit Product Category Label to QA Category Label, then Move filter to Total orders by product category and Save.
Switch to Portfolio Performance.
bugs.reason: Works as intended per human review.

bugs.name: Navigating back restores prior tab content but leaves the overflow tab highlighted
bugs.summary: Navigating back restores prior tab content but leaves the overflow tab highlighted.
bugs.expected: The tab bar updates to highlight and display the active tab corresponding to the loaded content.
bugs.actual: Dashboard content returns to the prior tab, but Tab 8 remains highlighted blue in the tab bar.

Create tabs until bar overflows; use a long tab name and eight tabs. Save.
Select a populated first tab, scroll tab bar right and select empty last Tab 8.
Press browser Back.
bugs.reason: Cannot reproduce on human review.

bugs.name: Product category orders per age chart includes all categories when Widget alone is selected
bugs.summary: Product category orders per age chart includes all categories when Widget alone is selected.
bugs.expected: The category-orders-per-age chart should display Widget only, matching selected Product Category and dashboard's 'filtered now for Widget' text.
bugs.actual: Widget is the sole selected category, and adjacent customer-satisfaction and order-discount charts reflect Widget, but Product category orders per age still has four-colored stacked bars and legend Doohickey, Gadget, Gizmo, Widget.
reproSteps: Open E-commerce Insights, use title menu Duplicate, supply unique name, check Only duplicate the dashboard and submit.
On own copy Overview select Vendor Alfreda Konopelski II Group and Add filter.
Open Product Category, uncheck Select all, check Widget, and click Update filter.
Visit Portfolio Performance and scroll to Product category orders per age.
bugs.reason: Works as intended: the example dashboard is user-editable, and a card only follows a dashboard filter once someone maps it; Metabase doesn't connect filters automatically.

bugs.name: Dashboard description collapses entered line breaks to a single line after blur
bugs.summary: Dashboard description collapses entered line breaks to a single line after blur.
bugs.expected: The description display preserves the two separate lines entered in the multiline editor.
bugs.actual: The editor visibly shows two lines, but after blur the description renders as one line: QA Lifecycle multiline first Second line café & <text>.
reproSteps: As Harbor Admin, open New > Dashboard; create a fresh dashboard prefixed QA Lifecycle with any description and save/exit initial editing mode.
Open the dashboard's More info panel and click its Description to edit.
Replace description with QA Lifecycle multiline first, press Enter, then type Second line café & <text>.
Blur the Description field and inspect its rendered text.
bugs.reason: Works as intended: descriptions render as Markdown, where a single newline is a soft break.

bugs.name: Undo after trashing a dashboard from the collection list does not restore its row
bugs.summary: Undo after trashing a dashboard from the collection list does not restore its row.
bugs.expected: Undo reverses the trash action and returns the dashboard to its original collection listing.
bugs.actual: For Lifecycle-Mo-7c21 Renamed, Undo was clicked successfully while visible, but its row did not return.

Return to Our analytics and open that dashboard row's Actions menu.
Choose Move to trash; verify its row disappears and the Trashed dashboard toast offers Undo.
Immediately click Undo while the toast is visible.
Observe that the dashboard row remains absent from the collection listing.
bugs.reason: Cannot reproduce on human review.

bugs.summary: Saving dashboard after deleting empty text card results in 'Save failed' and stays in editing mode.

bugs.name: Resized chart changes from roughly 444×236 to full-width 1048×86 after saving and refreshing
bugs.summary: Resized chart changes from roughly 444×236 to full-width 1048×86 after saving and refreshing.
bugs.expected: Saved chart dimensions and tab layout remain consistent after refresh.

bugs.name: Day of week grouping replaces Revenue per quarter value with visualization error
bugs.summary: Day of week grouping replaces Revenue per quarter value with visualization error.
bugs.expected: An offered grouping should keep connected dashboard cards usable, or unsupported grouping choices should be prevented for incompatible cards.
bugs.actual: Revenue and orders over time and revenue by product category group successfully by weekdays, but Revenue per quarter replaces its value with a warning icon and “Group only by a time field to see how this has changed over time.” The error persists after refresh.
reproSteps: With Date Grouping options All, no default and not required, open Date Grouping and click More….
Select Day of week.
Inspect Revenue per quarter and refresh.
bugs.reason: Works as intended: Trend needs a chronological time grouping, and Metabase deliberately shows its guidance message when a grouping such as day of week produces no insights. The dashboard filter offers every unit unless the author restricts it.

bugs.name: Card-local Date Grouping still changes another card after Move filter
bugs.summary: Card-local Date Grouping still changes another card after Move filter.
bugs.expected: As the editor states the card-local filter can only connect to its own card, changing it should not change Revenue per quarter's grouping/value.
bugs.actual: The filter is only in Revenue and orders over time, yet Revenue per quarter changes from 67,863.4 Q4 2026 to 24,730.43 Dec 2026 with previous month comparison; refresh retains this.
reproSteps: On QA-DATE duplicated from seed dashboard 1, clear Date Grouping to return Revenue per quarter to 67,863.4 for Q4 2026.
Edit dashboard, click Date Grouping, Move filter > Revenue and orders over time.
Observe other cards say “This filter can only connect to its own card.” Save.
In the card-local Date Grouping filter choose Month; inspect Revenue per quarter and refresh.
bugs.reason: Works as intended: moving a filter widget deliberately keeps existing card connections so users can see and disconnect them. The card stays connected (its mapping shows Disconnect), so the result follows the saved configuration.
